Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

This year, like the past several years, there will be a diverse group of people speaking at the freshman orientation. A Christian person and an Atheist person will be the first two speakers. The Christian speaker will talk about insights gained after decades of teaching biology at the university, while the Atheist speaker has a strong distaste for the sciences and is there to counter the work of the other. Who argues against scientific ideas?
A. The Christian one
B. The Atheist one
C. Not answerable
